First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no-drop, social. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @mcleancountywheelers the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the McLean County Wheelers Weekend Show & Go group ride

The Bloomington-Normal club's weekend no-drop ride. It leaves from the Brander Shelter at Underwood Park on the Constitution Trail. The focus is safe, social riding, not racing. Some weekends have a food stop as the destination. The club also runs evening ice cream rides and spring training rides for new riders.
